page.title: Smart Builder — build your Naya app
page.topic: The page where anyone builds a Naya app: pick a template or build custom, all from our pieces library.

sections.heading: Build your Naya app
sections.body: Pick a template or build custom — every piece below is real, working, and yours to compose.
sections.function: entry CTA scrolls to the template gallery

sections.heading: Twelve templates, pre-done
sections.body: Pick one, tweak it, build. The flagship personal page first — your world in one page.
sections.function: template pick opens the notes + part-swap step

sections.heading: Every piece in the library
sections.body: The full inventory — buttons, boards, banners, cards. What you see is what builds.

sections.heading: Find any piece
sections.body: Type 'buttons' — all the buttons come up. Filter by style and color.

sections.heading: Build from scratch
sections.body: Choose every part yourself. Most will pick a template — the custom path is here for those who want it.

sections.heading: Make it yours with notes
sections.body: Swap to button XYZ. This one in gold. Or just say: give me the functionality, make it personal to me.
sections.function: notes ride the contract into the build

sections.heading: Standard functions, on by default
sections.body: Smart mail, spaces, posting, personal reports, intelligence-today, contacts, smart tabs — every page ships with them. Toggle what you don't want.

sections.heading: Your personal hub
sections.body: Picture and cover photo at top — then your world. Private by default; sharing to NayaNET is your choice.
